source: Direct human message in this root conversation on 2026-10-06; full English translation follows.
complete_english_translation: One learning input should theoretically contain only K records because its primary information consists of statistical results. Process feedback only needs statistics, not excessive textual content. After N iterations, retain only N times K records and statistical results.

resolution.unit: one complete template system evaluated in one registered round
resolution.configured_K: derive from the immutable candidate list, never hardcode
resolution.learner_history: one record for each original candidate in each complete observed population; preserve rejected and unchanged candidates
learner_content: full editable node templates and assembly configuration
official business quality and reliability aggregates
aggregate node structure and measured performance
support, review, revision and postprocessing statistics with counts, denominators, missingness and intervals
source cohort and roster hash, policy identity, disposition and comparison references
excluded: per-input or per-visit records, even anonymous
task answers, labels, transcripts, knowledge contents or source lists
per-case summaries and long historical explanations
resolution.private_audit: Preserve full trajectories, paired observations, exact source pins, strata reports and cumulative exposure. Aggregate after complete-family qualification and exact root READ; never export a partial population.
resolution.iteration_accounting: N counts complete evaluated populations actually available in the validated lineage, including its initial observed population. Preserve their exact iteration labels; do not invent missing earlier rounds. Fixed K gives N times K records; independently registered changes to K require explicit sum-of-K accounting in a later schema.
resolution.comparison_metadata: Keep baseline/A/A numeric statistics once per source cohort as referenced metadata, outside the K candidate record list. Do not pool different source cohorts.
resolution.prospective_profile: aggregate-template-records-v1 under a new exact continuation registration; preserve every historical frozen actor input and response
